views.name: living-low-v02
views.prompt:
Use case: sketch-to-render / precise-object-edit.
Input image 1 is the sole geometric and camera anchor, a verified Blender rendering of this particular home. Transform it into ONE highly realistic architectural interior photograph, landscape 3:2. Preserve the exact camera, crop, perspective, walls, window positions and divisions, object counts, furniture footprints, heights, orientation and overlap. Improve surface and lighting realism only. No collage, inset, diagrams, words, watermark, people, UI or dimension text.
Design: understated modern Japanese; clean warm-white flat matte walls and ceiling, desaturated pale oak grain, greige fine-weave upholstery, sage-green and deep-navy accents. Avoid a yellow color cast. Natural believable contact shadows, soft window daylight and subtle existing indirect lighting. Detailed real linen-like weave, precise joinery, restrained satin ceramic and dark graphite frames. No new rugs, curtains, artwork, extra lighting fixtures, wall decoration or decorative clutter. No new furniture. Window background can be softly blurred neutral distant foliage/sky, only an illustrative backdrop; no added terrace, railing or room. Do not add any window mullions or divisions.
The tea set is LOW Japanese lounge furniture, not dining-height: one round pale-oak pedestal tea table diameter 700 mm and top height only 380 mm; two matching low armchairs with seat top 230 mm and total height 580 mm. Do not lift their tops, lengthen legs, create raised flooring or convert to normal dining furniture. Keep table footprint and two chairs facing left-right parallel to the glass as modeled. Sage seat cushions, rounded greige back pads, pale timber arms. Table only has one walnut tray with one ceramic pot and two small cups. Tiny tabletop props remain at real scale. Preserve the floor at one level.
This is the full living-room view toward the balcony. Keep the 85-inch TV on the LEFT wall and the long low cream TV cabinet with pale oak top. The greige L sofa is on the RIGHT, its chaise nearest the window, one sage and one deep navy cushion; separate greige ottoman at foreground right. The rounded rectangular pale-oak coffee tabletop in the center is completely EMPTY, lower shelf also empty. No books, vase or tray on this coffee table. Behind the sofa keep exactly one long double-person desk, ONE 34-inch monitor, ONE navy lamp, ONE tiny potted plant, ONE pencil holder and ONE mug, exactly ONE office chair. Bookcase remains in place with books only; no hanging plants, extra pots or vases in the bookcase. Washer and dryer remain stacked at window right.
Preserve the low tea chairs and table in their existing balcony locations even though the sofa hides most of them in this particular camera view; do not move or enlarge the tea set to reveal it. The near chair's low back and green seat are visible at the window, the other chair is mostly occluded by the chaise. Keep those overlaps. Three floor plants remain clustered to the left of the window at the TV end, in their original pots and relative positions. Main window has one very wide uninterrupted central fixed pane and two narrower side bays, each side bay divided upper/lower, five panes total. Soft realistic daytime, light clean warmth.

Keep their scale and natural contact shadows. Preserve everything else pixel-faithfully: camera, crop, low table 380 mm tall, two low chairs with 230 mm seats, sofa, plants, window, materials, outdoor view, daylight and all geometry.
